title: Extend SpringBoneSimulator3D to detect collisions to the chain between the joints
body:
* Partly closes https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/14581

This is about detecting collisions between `SpringBoneCollisionSphere3D` and any bone chains in a `SpringBoneSimulator3D`, and handles it in a way that would be expected to a player who imagined the bone chain as a continuous sequence of overlapping capsules rather than as disconnected spheres around the joints.

**Limitations:**
The `SpringBoneCollisionPlane3D` case does not need to change because the tapered capsule cannot touch a plane without the spheres at either end also touching.

The `SpringBoneCollisionCapsule3D` case is not implemented.  (The implementation will probably be to calculate the best virtual sphere in the capsule responsible for contact and call `SpringBoneCollisionSphere3D::_collide_sphere_taper()`.)

The `inside` case is not implemented.  (It's not obvious what the this case is intended for, since it tries to scrunch up all the joints of every bone chain into the same Collision Shape and therefore doesn't work as a grab.) 

There is no setting to disable this feature.  (It makes things more complicated and I am not sure who would prefer it.)

**Videos:**
New: With bone chain collisions on tapered cones between the joints;
[Screencast From 2026-04-06 15-39-12.webm](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/51213a18-9b2d-48d8-939f-efa1be81d0a2)

Old: Without bone chain collisions between the joints.
[Screencast From 2026-04-06 15-45-36.webm](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3051c865-8afb-42b6-a724-2381c79ffed4)

This is enough to experiment whether this feature can perform adequately on avatars in contrast to [VRChat's PhysBones](https://creators.vrchat.com/common-components/physbones/).  Subject to this working, the missing features are: (A) grabbing, (B) posing, (C) angular limits, (D) stretch and squish, (E) branching bone chains.

Demo project:  https://github.com/goatchurchprime/skeleton-issues
